**Education only.** Open EP Mapping Lab teaches the engineering principles behind cardiac
electroanatomic mapping systems. It is not medical advice. Do not use it for diagnosis,
treatment or any clinical decision.

**Content may contain errors.** Modules are drafted with AI assistance and checked by
recomputing results in code and verifying citations. Human expert review is recorded per
module, and each module shows its review status at the top. Known errors are listed on the
[errata](errata.qmd) page.

**No warranty.** Content and code are provided as is, without warranty of any kind.

**Hardware.** Any bench or hardware material is for bench use only. It must never be
connected to a person or an animal.

**Trademarks and independence.** Product, catheter and software names — including CARTO, EnSite,
Rhythmia, OPAL HDx, KODEX-EPD, AcQMap, PentaRay, OCTARAY, Advisor HD Grid, IntellaMap Orion,
ThermoCool SmartTouch, TactiFlex, IntellaNav StablePoint, LUMIPOINT, CONFIDENSE, VISITAG and
CARTOSOUND — are trademarks of their respective owners. They are used only to identify and describe
products from public sources. Open EP Mapping Lab is an independent educational project and is not
affiliated with or endorsed by any device manufacturer or by the OpenEP (`openep.io`) project.
